root_cause: RTL sets dout to all-ones ('1) during async reset instead of all-zeros ('0), violating the spec ('clears dout'), verification plan (reset_value.dout: 0), and reference model (reset() returns dout=0). The frozen TB assertion check_reset_clean_state asserts dout==0 whenever rst_n==0, which fires during every test's reset phase, crashing all 13 tests with a Python AssertionError before UVM infrastructure can report.
